statement: 11.3 Complexity analysis The BKZ algorithm is guaranteed to terminate after at most O (β n ) tours. This fact implies that, for any lattice, a β-BKZ-reduced basis always exists. However, it remains an open question whether the number of tours can be bounded by a polynomial in the lattice dimension n. In practical implementations, BKZ is terminated after successive tours no longer produce a significant improvement in the quality of the basis. The complexity analysis presented here assumes such early-abort strategies are employed.
